objective: Reuse the sealed repaired CUDA image and exact offline inputs to rerun Gate 0B on one Standard A100 with the corrected Transformers 5.15.1 kernel-dispatch qualifier; perform only the bounded 16-record optimizer/save/reload/merge qualification smoke, not seed-pilot or main training.

required_explicit_scope: upload a content-sealed workspace, controller, metadata wrapper, run plan, and this card to a new run-scoped prefix in the existing GCS bucket
create one temporary VPC and subnet with Private Google Access and no router, NAT, or external IP
create one Standard a2-highgpu-1g A100 40 GB qualification VM
perform the bounded 16-record Gate 0B optimizer, adapter save/reload, safe-merge, and peak-VRAM smoke only
read the exact generation-pinned reused inputs and read/write only the new run-scoped GCS evidence
stop and delete the A100 VM only after terminal evidence is backed up and independently verified
delete the temporary subnet and VPC after verified terminal backup and prove all run-scoped resources absent

qualification.network: Private Google Access only; no external IP, router, or NAT; network-disabled qualification container
qualification.scope: package, CUDA/Triton/FLA and resolved external-kernel identity; text-only model load; adapter target/gradient smoke; bounded peak-VRAM qualification

mandatory_sequence: freeze and hash the commit workspace, controller, wrapper, run plan, and card
after explicit approval, upload those inputs to new generation-pinned GCS objects
seal a run-specific manifest with exact resource names, project, region, zone, service account, boot image, input generations, hashes, and pre-create absence
create the temporary no-NAT VPC, subnet, and one bounded Standard A100 VM
download and independently verify the exact reused image, bundle, model, and new workspace before execution
run the fail-closed network-disabled qualification and propagate a nonempty attempt ID into the container
back up terminal logs, raw outputs, identities, hashes, and result to GCS
independently verify the initial terminal backup using two generation-pinned full-object reads
stop the A100 VM after the initial terminal backup passes independent verification
capture stopped VM identity and provider evidence, upload them, and independently verify the complete generation-pinned set
pass the deletion gate against the verified terminal backup and stopped provider identity
delete the A100 VM, back up deletion evidence, delete the subnet and VPC, and prove all run-scoped compute, disk, and network resources absent
hard_stops: no explicit GCloud approval for this exact card
any input, generation, size, SHA-256, source commit, or pre-create absence mismatch
more than one GPU is visible
attempt ID is absent from the qualification container
CUDA, Triton, FLA, external kernel resolution, package, model, adapter, gradient, merge, or VRAM check fails
terminal backup, independent generation-pinned verification, deletion gate, or absence proof fails
success_boundary: Gate 0B passes only if the corrected A100 qualification and bounded 16-record training smoke complete with all checks passed and complete sealed evidence; otherwise preserve the failure and tear down without seed-pilot or main training.
